# Lines where Emetos tokenizes a colorize fixture differently from VS Code (step 4.6, SPEC §8.1).
# One range per line: <fixture> <first line>-<last line> <reason>. Lines count from 1.
# A range whose lines no longer differ fails the test, so an entry goes when its cause is fixed.

# Markdown embeds the grammar of the language of a fenced block, and a block whose grammar is not
# bundled yet is not highlighted: the rule of the block is left out, as vscode-textmate does when an
# included grammar is missing. The entries go when the language is bundled.
issue-279576.md 1-11 C# is not one of the bundled languages

# md-math.md needs the markdown-math extension, which injects the math grammar into Markdown; it
# is not bundled, so the math is plain text. The extension is out of scope of D13.
md-math.md 1-173 the markdown-math extension (LaTeX in Markdown) is not bundled
